content.short: Genopets is a move-to-earn NFT RPG on Solana that rewards users for physical activity by evolving digital pets.
content.description:
Genopets is a Free-to-Play, Move-to-Earn NFT RPG on Solana that makes living an active lifestyle rewarding. By syncing data from wearable devices, the game converts real-world steps into Energy, allowing players to upgrade their Genopet and participate in challenges. The project combines move-to-earn mechanics with traditional RPG elements to create a unique experience.

The ecosystem utilizes the GENE token for governance and KI for in-game utility. Players can own Habitats to craft items and earn rewards. By bridging physical health with digital assets, Genopets aims to onboard users into Web3 gaming through a sustainable model.
